install.caption: App
install.title: Install DailyLogic on your device
install.description: Open tools instantly from your home screen — works offline for pages you’ve already visited.
install.iosStep1: Tap the Share button in Safari
install.iosStep2: Scroll and choose “Add to Home Screen”.
install.iosStep3: Confirm with “Add” — the app icon will appear on your home screen.
install.desktopStep1: Open this site in Chrome, Edge, or another Chromium browser.
install.desktopStep2: Look for the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu (⋮).
